Heroic hand-painted style, matte, broad simple shapes, extremely restrained brush texture. Must read at just 31 pixels: simple outer silhouette, large negative spaces, no fine detail. Consistent thick forms and quiet charcoal circular background. Outside circle transparent. Exactly one icon, no text, no lettering, no ornament border, no extra symbols, no 3D pedestal, no environment, no glow. Original text-only design; no published deity or product.
resizing: unchanged source centered on transparent square, Lanczos to31/128/256; no repaint
blind_31:
